entities.summary: Francisco Anthony "Frank" Lorenzo is an American corporate raider and former airline executive best known for his controversial and destructive tenure in the U.S. airline industry during the 1970s and 1980s. Through his holding company, Texas Air Corporation, Lorenzo gained control of Texas International Airlines, Continental Airlines, New York Air, People Express, Frontier Airlines, and finally Eastern Air Lines.
